holes.body:
/-- The stable part of the third offset: `pi_(n+3)(S^n) = C24` for `n >= 5`. -/
theorem sphere_third_offset_stable_mulEquiv_zmod_twenty_four
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 5 ≤ n) :
    Nonempty
      (HomotopyGroup.Pi (n + 3) (SphereSpace n) (sphereBasepoint n) ≃*
        Multiplicative (ZMod 24)) := by
  sorry
